title: Spend approval to enable a campaign
intro: Enabling a campaign starts real spend. It needs a request, a human approval with a budget cap, and then the enable action. Nothing is sent to Google Ads before that.

fields.requestedByBot: Requested by an automated agent (API key)
fields.requestBudgetHelp: The approver sets the final cap. The campaign cannot be enabled above it.
fields.approveCapHelp: Enabling is refused if the campaign's real daily budget is above this cap.

hint.consumed: This approval was already used and cannot be reused. Request a new one to enable the campaign again.
hint.rejected: This request was rejected. You can request a new approval.
hint.expired: This approval expired. Request a new one.
hint.cannotRequest: Your role ({{role}}) cannot request spend approvals.
hint.waitingOwner: Waiting for an owner to approve this request.
hint.readyToEnable: Approved. Enabling will start real spend on this account.
hint.approvedWaitingOwner: Approved. An owner must enable the campaign.

errors.badRequest: The request was not valid. Check the values and try again.
errors.unauthorized: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.forbidden: Not allowed: your role, the approval, the budget cap or the account does not permit this action.
errors.notFound: The account or approval is no longer available for this organization. Reload and reconnect the account if needed.
errors.conflict: This approval was already decided or used. Reload to see its current status.
errors.invalidBudget: Enter a budget greater than zero (and not below the requested budget).
errors.killSwitch: Spend operations are suspended by the kill-switch.
errors.platform: Google Ads could not confirm the campaign budget or the change. Nothing was enabled; check the account and try again.
errors.network: Network error. Check your connection and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
